files.basis: SOURCE_READ only. Nothing here has run. By the directive's ladder, reading can support at most R2 (input/state/update resemblance); R3+ needs the wind tunnel. Every row names the two organ ids and the level CLAIMED, the level a wind-tunnel test could reach, and which of the directive's two interesting cases it might be (HUMAN_SEPARATED_BEHAVIOURALLY_NEAR / HUMAN_SIMILAR_BEHAVIOURALLY_FAR). These are hypotheses; the directive forbids reading them as equivalence.
files.calibration: row 1 is a KNOWN-IDENTICAL pair by descent (Karn's RS derives from Rockliff's); a Stage E instrument that does not place it at R5 is broken; an instrument that places libfec's Viterbi as close to them as they are to each other is fooled by the domain label. Row 2 (Feistel vs SPN) is the KNOWN-DIFFERENT pair with the same human label.
